import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Ensure the dataset 'sleep_health.csv' is in a 'data' directory.")
    # Create a dummy dataframe for the script to run without error if file is not found
    data = {
        'Person ID': range(10), 'Gender': ['Male']*5 + ['Female']*5, 'Age': range(27, 37),
        'Occupation': ['Software Engineer']*10, 'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 7.8, 5.9, 6.0, 7.1, 7.2, 7.8, 7.9, 8.0],
        'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 8, 4, 5, 8, 9, 9, 9, 9], 'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 75, 30, 35, 75, 80, 80, 80, 80],
        'Stress Level': [6, 8, 3, 8, 7, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3], 'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Normal'],
        'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '117/76', '140/90', '135/88', '115/75', '118/75', '118/75', '118/75', '118/75'],
        'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 70, 85, 82, 68, 70, 70, 70, 70], 'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 8000, 3000, 3500, 8000, 8000, 8000, 8000, 8000],
        'Sleep Disorder': [None, None, None, 'Insomnia', 'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea', None, None, None, None]
    }
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Clean up the 'Sleep Disorder' column for better visualization
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Define order for BMI Category for logical plotting
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create a figure with a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Sleep Health Factors', fontsize=20, weight='bold', y=1.0)

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level by Sleep Disorder ---
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(30, 200),
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder & Activity')

# --- Plot 2: Quality of Sleep Distribution by Occupation ---
# Aggregate data for clarity
occupation_order = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Occupation',
    order=occupation_order,
    palette='crest'
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quality of Sleep Across Occupations', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)

# --- Plot 3: Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics ---
corr_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Systolic', 'Diastolic', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[corr_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=correlation_matrix,
    annot=True,
    cmap='coolwarm',
    fmt=".2f",
    linewidths=.5
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

# --- Plot 4: Systolic Blood Pressure by BMI and Gender ---
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Systolic',
    hue='Gender',
    split=True,
    inner='quart',
    palette={'Male': 'b', 'Female': 'y'}
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Systolic Blood Pressure by BMI and Gender', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Gender')

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
